create_scene_visualization: create a Scene with rooms and config, then call plot() to render propositions as matplotlib figures
sort_rooms_by_instruction: sort a list of Room objects by relevance to a natural language instruction using keyword matching
plot_object_to_receptacle_lines: plot curved arrows from objects to receptacles on a matplotlib axis to visualize spatial relationships
update_rooms_object_mappings: update object-to-receptacle and object-to-room mappings by moving objects across rooms based on propositions
plot_room_rows: plot a row of rooms on a matplotlib axis with redistributed widths and return height bounds
